name: LCARS Starship
description: A starship console in LCARS style: elbow blocks in gold, orange and purple on black, the time, date, power, steps, heart rate and temperature in labelled panels, and a viewscreen with a 3D-rendered starship at warp. Meters, a data ticker, a button grid and a shimmering power bar keep the console busy.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1
project.groups = project.groups || {}; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name) && e.group) project.groups[e.group] = 'Clock AOD' } return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Weekday","Day"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gDate'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gPower = 'Power'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Power bar","Power shimmer","Battery"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gPower'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gSensors = 'Sensors'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Steps","Heart rate","Temperature"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gSensors'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gActivity = 'Activity panels'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Date signal","Time meters","Data ticker","Button grid"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gActivity'; n++ } } return n
